countercheck: QC3 independent negative controls + census cross-checks

NCQ3_imm32_census.control: independent whole-file census of imm32 0x4E22 / ASCII 20002 / mangles
NCQ3_imm32_census.expected_failure: if the executor's census were wrong, counts/offsets would disagree

NCQ4_tlv_absence.mutation: record 0 payload with entry count 6 -> 5 (the tag-0x11 entry then consumes the TAIL bytes as its value)
